About Wash 66

Value for you, care for our environment.

A soft-touch tunnel for Kennebecasis Valley

Wash 66 opened on Pettingill Road in Quispamsis in 2019, bringing a soft-touch express exterior tunnel wash to the greater Saint John area. You stay in your car, the conveyor does the driving, and most cars are clean in about two minutes.

Our slogan is Armour your car, and we mean it. An unwashed car is exposed to road salt, grime and the salt fog that's common along the Maritime coast. That buildup works on paint, brake lines and the underbody, and it also coats your windshield, lights and signals. For most people a car is one of their biggest purchases, and regular washing is one of the cheapest ways to make it last.

Easier on local water

A driveway wash can use up to 100 gallons of water, and the soap, grime and road salt run straight into the storm sewer. Our wash water reclamation system treats the water before returning it to nature and recycles almost all of what we use, for a net loss of only 10 to 12 gallons per vehicle.

Save time and effort, and go easier on Kennebecasis Valley, by bringing your car to Wash 66.
